name: stop_command
description: Stop a command started with start_command: its whole process group is killed. You get how it ended and the last 4 KiB of its output, and the id still reads the rest with read_output. It is safe to call again: for a command that has ended it says how it ended. Example: {"id":"o-3f9c2a17b0d4e8a1"}

id.description: The command's id, from start_command or list_commands
